_comment: Wakeable machines. Used by `uv run python -m hardware.bench.wake`. A null mac means the address has not been captured yet — the tool refuses to wake that host and says how to get it.

hosts.name: cell1
hosts.note: Minisforum UM350. Captured 2026-07-28 from enp4s0, the NIC carrying 192.168.86.202. NOTE: the board has a SECOND Realtek NIC, enp3s0 at 1c:83:41:30:ec:2c - one digit apart, currently NO-CARRIER. If WoL is ever enabled on the wrong port this is why.
